comments.body: Is this available in the current world clock?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The recipe for this dress comes from the Earl of Leicester, and is available during World Clock, 16th Century's phase 5, and 17th Century's phases 1 and 2.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?WorldClock/item
Images: japaneseteacom2.blog21.fc2.com/blog-entry-807.html

Its stats are:

+1 Metal trading
+1 Merchandise Knowledge
female-only
8k total fame to equip
